verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documented input/output guardrail feature that validates, transforms, or blocks unsafe content. Callbacks are described only as lifecycle hooks for logging, monitoring, or side-effects, and Tool Confirmation is a human-in-the-loop approval step for tool execution. Both are adjacent building blocks, not content guardrails, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As a developer, I can attach input/output guardrails that validate, transform, or block unsafe content
